items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: You were over there? The whole Freddie Coleman band?

ctx.x: You were over there? The whole Freddie Coleman band? Yeah. I didn't know they went over there.
Oh man, we went, we went, quite a few places. We had a pretty nice little band. Not to say our band was at the Mardi Grimes.
